name: delete_registered_plugin
description: Resolves install_generated_plugin's 'already registered' conflict the other way: deletes this plugin's local dev store registration entirely, then clears the locally-known nsid so the next install_generated_plugin call registers it fresh. Does not uninstall the plugin if it's currently installed -- call uninstall_installed_plugin for that, separately, if needed. Requires a locally-known nsid; fails if there isn't one. This is a real, permanent change on the hub -- always confirm with the customer first.

location.description: The 'location' a generate_plugin_scaffold/list_generated_plugins call returned, identifying which generated plugin's registration to delete.
